promotions.title: Activate Money Safe, Get a Pacific Coffee Voucher
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Receive HKD 30 Pacific Coffee e-Cash Voucher when you activate Money Safe
promotions.description: Customers who deposit any amount into a Money Safe account receive a HKD 30 Pacific Coffee e-Cash Voucher as a reward. Simply log in to the EleBank App and activate the Money Safe feature to be eligible for this voucher. The Money Safe account offers anti-fraud protection introduced by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority while maintaining the same savings and time deposit interest rates as regular accounts, with funds unlockable only through in-person appointment. This promotion is available on a limited quota, first come first served basis.
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first come first served

promotions.title: EleBank Visa Card Air Tickets Cash Rebate – Up to HKD 800
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Earn up to HKD 800 cash rebate on air ticket purchases with EleBank Visa Card
promotions.description: EleBank Visa cardholders who use their registered eligible Visa Card to book air tickets via official Hong Kong or Macau websites of Air New Zealand, ANA, Ethiopian Airlines, EVA AIR, or Singapore Airlines can earn cash rebates. A single transaction of HKD 8,000 or above qualifies for HKD 800 cash rebate (maximum once per customer during the promotion period), while transactions between HKD 4,000–HKD 7,999 qualify for HKD 240 cash rebate. Promotion periods vary by airline, and customers should refer to the #TravelWithVisa Terms & Conditions for specific dates and eligibility requirements. This offer is available on a limited quota, first come first served basis.
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first come first served; maximum HKD 800 rebate per customer once

promotions.title: Travel with Visa – Flight Booking Cash Rebate (HKD800 Maximum)
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Earn up to HKD 800 cash rebate on air ticket purchases with your Visa Card
promotions.description: EleBank Visa cardholders can earn cash rebates when booking flights through the official Hong Kong or Macau websites of Air New Zealand, ANA, Ethiopian Airlines, EVA AIR, or Singapore Airlines. Customers who charge a single transaction of HKD 8,000 or above receive HKD 800 cash rebate (maximum once per promotion period), while transactions between HKD 4,000 and HKD 7,999 receive HKD 240 cash rebate. The promotion period varies by airline, and the offer is available on a first-come, first-served basis with limited quota. Eligible cardholders must use their registered Visa Card to pay for the air tickets on the designated airline websites.
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first come first served

promotions.title: EleBank Visa Platinum Card with Transaction Protection
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Real-time fraud protection with 24/7 Shield Monitoring
promotions.description: The EleBank Visa Platinum Card offers comprehensive transaction security protection with its Shield Monitoring feature. This feature provides 24/7 real-time fraud protection to keep cardholders' transactions secure at all times. The card provides premium banking services with no limitations, allowing customers to enjoy stellar services regardless of their assets or status. Cardholders can apply directly through the EleBank app and manage their card alongside other banking services on the same platform.

promotions.title: EleBank 5-Minute Mobile Account Opening
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open a bank account in as fast as 5 minutes via mobile
promotions.description: EleBank offers a streamlined account opening process that can be completed in as little as 5 minutes through your mobile device. This digital banking service allows customers to quickly access EleBank's financial technology ecosystem without visiting a physical branch. The bank continually innovates the banking concept to create stellar banking services shared by everyone. EleBank is a licensed digital bank approved by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, ensuring all services meet regulatory standards.

promotions.title: No Account Management Fees and No Minimum Deposit
promotions.highlight: 💸 No account management fees and no minimum deposit requirements
promotions.description: EleBank offers fee-free banking services with no account management fees and no minimum deposit requirements. This policy makes banking accessible to all customers regardless of their financial status or account balance. Customers can enjoy the full range of EleBank's digital banking services without worrying about maintenance fees or having to maintain minimum balances. This approach aligns with EleBank's mission to provide inclusive banking services to everyone, regardless of assets or status.

promotions.title: EleBank Personal Loan with Preferential Interest Rates
promotions.highlight: 💰 Personal loans up to 12x monthly salary with customized rates
promotions.description: EleBank offers personal loans with customized interest rates tailored to individual customers. Loan amounts can reach up to 12 times the customer's monthly salary or HKD1,000,000 (whichever is lower). The entire loan process, from application to fund disbursement, can be completed in as fast as 5 minutes. The actual annual percentage rate ranges from 7.43% to 35.05%, with repayment periods from 6 to 60 months. EleBank provides this 24/7 real-time service to meet customers' urgent financing needs.

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Savings Account with No Minimum Balance
promotions.highlight: 💱 Flexible deposit accounts with no minimum balance in multiple currencies
promotions.description: EleBank provides multi-currency deposit accounts with no minimum balance requirements. Customers can choose from flexible time deposit periods with the ability to open deposits 24/7. The service includes both demand deposits and time deposits in multiple currencies. EleBank also offers interest rate boost coupons that allow customers to earn additional interest on their deposits. Customers can manage their deposits conveniently through the EleBank app, with the flexibility to access their funds when needed.

promotions.title: Flexible Time Deposit with Interest Rate Boost Coupons
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Flexible term time deposits available 24/7
promotions.description: EleBank offers flexible time deposits that can be opened anytime through their 24/7 digital banking platform. Customers can choose from various term options to suit their financial needs. The service includes the option to use interest rate boosters to earn higher returns on deposits. This time deposit service is available to all EleBank customers and can be managed entirely through the EleBank app without needing to visit a branch.

promotions.title: 24/7 Multi-Currency Foreign Exchange
promotions.highlight: 💱 Round-the-clock currency exchange with real-time rates for 11 currencies
promotions.description: EleBank offers 24/7 foreign exchange services with real-time quotes, allowing customers to buy and sell currencies at any time. The service supports exchanges between 11 currencies including Hong Kong Dollar, US Dollar, and Renminbi. Transactions are processed instantly with funds immediately credited to the customer's account upon exchange. This service enables customers to take advantage of favorable exchange rates at any hour of the day without being restricted by traditional banking hours.

promotions.title: Multi-Channel Instant Transfers
promotions.highlight: 📲 Multiple transfer options including FPS and instant transfers
promotions.description: EleBank provides comprehensive transfer services supporting multiple currencies including HKD, USD, and RMB. Customers can transfer funds using various identifiers such as mobile numbers, email addresses, or account numbers. The service includes 24/7 instant transfers for HKD and RMB through the Faster Payment System (FPS). All transfer services are accessible through the EleBank app, providing convenient fund movement at any time.

promotions.title: Money Safe Deposit Protection
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced fraud protection for deposits while maintaining interest earnings
promotions.description: EleBank's Money Safe feature provides upgraded protection to help customers avoid fraud-related losses. This security measure allows customers to lock their funds while still earning the same interest rates as regular demand deposits or time deposits. The locked funds can only be accessed through an in-person appointment, adding an extra layer of security. This feature is part of the anti-fraud measures introduced by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to protect customer deposits from unauthorized access or fraudulent transfers.

promotions.title: 24/7 Digital Banking Services
promotions.highlight: 🕗 Round-the-clock access to banking services
promotions.description: EleBank provides 24/7 digital banking services allowing customers to manage their finances anytime, anywhere. Customers can access a complete range of banking services including transfers, deposits, loans, and foreign currency exchange through a single app. The service includes 24-hour customer service hotline support for any assistance needed. This always-on banking platform ensures maximum convenience for all EleBank customers regardless of time constraints.

While funds are locked in the Money Safe, they continue to earn the same interest rates as regular savings or time deposits. Funds can only be unlocked through an in-person appointment, providing an additional layer of security against fraud.

promotions.description: EleBank's Money Safe is an anti-fraud feature introduced by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. It allows customers to lock funds while still earning the same savings/time deposit interest rates, with funds only unlockable through in-person appointments.

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Foreign Exchange Service
promotions.highlight: 🗓️ Open time deposits 24/7 with flexible terms
promotions.description: EleBank offers flexible time deposit options that can be opened 24/7 through the mobile app. Customers can choose from various tenor options with the possibility of using interest rate boost coupons for enhanced returns.

promotions.title: Bank Securities Transfer: 7*24 Instant Arrival
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Real-time fund transfers between securities and bank accounts
promotions.description: Transfer funds instantly between your securities and bank accounts at EleBank. Supports HKD, USD, and RMB with real-time processing available 24/7 for seamless investment management.

promotions.title: Personal Loan with Fast Approval
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Loan funds disbursed in as fast as 5 minutes
promotions.description: EleBank offers expedited loan processing with disbursement that can be completed in as little as 5 minutes from application to fund transfer. Available 24/7 for customer convenience.

promotions.title: 0 Handling Fee for the First Remittance to Chinese Mainland
promotions.highlight: 💸 First remittance to Chinese Mainland with 0 fees + receives as soon as 1 hour!
promotions.description: Customers can enjoy zero handling fee on their first remittance to Chinese Mainland via the Airstar Bank App using 'Remit to Chinese Mainland·WeRemit'. This is a one-time offer per customer with limited quota available on a first-come, first-served basis.
promotions.quota: One-time offer per customer, limited quota available

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Transfer Options
promotions.highlight: 💱 Trade currencies 24/7 with real-time quotes
promotions.description: Airstar Bank offers 24/7 foreign exchange service with real-time quotes. Customers can trade instantly with immediate transfers and the service supports 11 currencies including HKD, USD, CNY, and more.

promotions.title: Quick Loan Approval and Disbursement
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Complete loan process in as fast as 5 minutes
promotions.description: Apply for a personal loan with Airstar Bank and receive funds in as little as 5 minutes from application to disbursement. Loan amounts available up to 12 times your monthly salary or HKD1,000,000, whichever is lower.
promotions.cost: Variable interest rates from 7.43% to 35.05% APR

promotions.title: Pay Shield Real-Time Fraud Protection
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ 24/7 real-time fraud protection for payments
promotions.description: Pay Shield provides Airstar Bank Visa Platinum Card users with round-the-clock real-time fraud protection for their payments. This security feature helps detect and prevent fraudulent transactions, offering customers peace of mind when making purchases.
promotions.quota: Available to all Visa Platinum Card holders

promotions.title: Low Fee Stock Trading with Fractional Shares
promotions.highlight: 💹 Trade HK stocks from HK$18 and US stocks from US$1.99
promotions.description: Access global markets with low-cost trading fees. Trade Hong Kong stocks from as low as HK$18 per order and US stocks at just US$1.99 per order. Includes fractional shares options starting from just 1 share for HK stocks or US$5 for US stocks.
promotions.cost: From HK$18 for HK stocks, US$1.99 for US stocks

promotions.title: Personal Loan with Loan Disbursement in 5 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 💵 Loans up to 12x monthly salary with flexible APR rates
promotions.description: Airstar Bank offers personal loans with personalized APR ranging from 7.43% to 35.05% and repayment periods of 6 to 60 months. Total loan amount can be up to 12 times of monthly salary or HKD1,000,000, whichever is lower.
promotions.cost: Interest based on APR ranging from 7.43% to 35.05%

promotions.title: No Minimum Balance Requirement
promotions.highlight: 💳 No account management fees and no minimum deposit
promotions.description: Airstar Bank offers savings accounts with no minimum balance requirement. Multi-currency savings options are available with no account management fees.

promotions.title: eM+ High Yield Account (Libra Savings) with up to 2.0% p.a. Interest Rate
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to 2.0% p.a. on your savings
promotions.description: Customers who successfully upgrade to eM+ High Yield Account (Libra Savings) through the AlipayHK App can enjoy up to 2.0% p.a. interest rate. The 2.0% rate applies to deposits between HKD 200,000-800,000, while deposits up to HKD 200,000 earn 0.5% p.a.

promotions.title: SME Loan Cash Rebate Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💸 Get up to HKD 100,000 cash rebate on first SME loan drawdown
promotions.description: SME customers who make their first loan drawdown can enjoy a cash rebate of up to HKD 100,000. This limited-time promotion aims to support small and medium enterprises with their financing needs.
promotions.quota: SME customers making their first loan drawdown

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Savings Account Upgrade
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Savings account now supports HKD, RMB and USD
promotions.description: Ant Bank's savings account has been upgraded to support multiple currencies including Hong Kong Dollar, Renminbi and US Dollar. Customers can manage all their currencies in one account for greater convenience.

promotions.title: Time Deposit with Early Withdrawal Without Penalty
promotions.highlight: 💹 Withdraw time deposits early with zero penalty fees
promotions.description: Ant Bank allows customers to withdraw their time deposits before maturity without incurring any penalty fees. This provides greater flexibility for customers to access their funds when needed, although early withdrawals must be for the full amount rather than partial withdrawals.
promotions.quota: Available to all time deposit customers

promotions.title: Direct Transfer from Libra Savings to Third-Party Accounts
promotions.highlight: ↗️ Transfer directly from Libra Savings to third-party accounts
promotions.description: Ant Bank now allows customers to transfer funds directly from their Libra Savings account to third-party accounts. This new feature enhances the flexibility and convenience of using the Libra Savings account.

promotions.title: Investment Fund - HKD 1 Minimum Subscription
promotions.highlight: 💹 Invest in funds with as low as HKD 1
promotions.description: Ant Bank allows customers to invest in funds with a minimum subscription amount of just HKD 1. This ultra-low entry threshold makes fund investments accessible to everyone regardless of their investment budget.

promotions.title: Investment Account Opening in 1 Minute
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open an investment account in as fast as 1 minute
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers a seamless investment account opening experience that can be completed in as little as 1 minute. No income proof required, allowing customers to start investing immediately after account opening.

promotions.title: One-Stop Hong Kong and US Stock Trading Platform
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Trade Hong Kong and US stocks in one platform
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers a one-stop trading platform connecting Hong Kong and US stock markets. The platform provides global investment solutions including Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, ETFs, and more.

promotions.title: Time Deposit with Low Minimum Deposit
promotions.highlight: 💲 Time deposits starting from as low as HKD 1
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers time deposits with an extremely low minimum amount of just HKD 1. This makes time deposits accessible to all customers regardless of their savings amount, allowing everyone to enjoy higher interest rates.

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Time Deposit
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Time deposits available in both HKD and USD
promotions.description: Ant Bank's time deposit service supports both Hong Kong dollars and US dollars. This gives customers the flexibility to earn interest on their deposits in different currencies according to their financial needs.

promotions.title: Guaranteed Safe Deposit Service
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced security for your bank deposits
promotions.description: Ant Bank has launched the Safe Lock Deposit Service, an anti-fraud measure initiated by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. This service allows customers to lock their spare deposits, preventing transfers through any channels to reduce the risk of fraud.

promotions.title: Ant Bank Investment Fund Platform Transaction Fee Waiver
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Zero fees for fund subscriptions and redemptions
promotions.description: Customers can enjoy fee waivers on fund subscriptions and redemptions on Ant Bank's new investment fund platform. The bank does not charge any platform fees, offering a truly zero-cost investment experience.

promotions.title: Increased Daily Transfer Limit
promotions.highlight: 💳 Daily transfer limit increased to HKD 1 million
promotions.description: Ant Bank has increased the daily transfer limit to up to HKD 1 million. Customers can now transfer larger amounts directly from Libra Savings to third-party accounts through the Ant Bank APP.

promotions.title: Secure Deposit Protection Service
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced security for your deposits with Smart Lock feature
promotions.description: Ant Bank has launched the Smart Lock Deposit Service, an anti-fraud measure introduced by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. This service allows customers to lock their spare deposits which cannot be transferred out through any channels, reducing the risk of fraudsters immediately transferring funds out of accounts.

promotions.title: Regular Fund Investment Feature
promotions.highlight: 📈 Set up regular investments from HKD 1
promotions.description: Ant Bank's new regular fund investment feature allows customers to set up periodic investments with amounts as low as HKD 1. This feature helps diversify risk and smooth out market volatility through dollar-cost averaging.

promotions.title: Insurance Products with Annual Rate up to 3.6%
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open an investment account in as fast as 1 minute
promotions.description: Customers can open an investment account in as little as 1 minute through the Ant Bank app or AlipayHK mini app. The streamlined process requires no income proof and offers immediate access to investment services after completion.
promotions.quota: All eligible customers aged 18+ who are not US/Canadian residents and are physically in Hong Kong during account opening

promotions.title: Fixed Deposit Zero Penalty for Early Withdrawal
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ No penalty for early withdrawals of fixed deposits
promotions.description: Customers can withdraw their entire fixed deposit before maturity without any penalty fees. The service supports HKD and USD deposits with a low minimum deposit amount of HKD 1.

promotions.title: Investment Account Opening in 1 Minute
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open investment account in as quick as 1 minute
promotions.description: Customers can open an investment account with Ant Bank in as little as 1 minute. This seamless account opening process requires no income proof and allows customers to start investing immediately after completion.

promotions.title: Enhanced Fund Transfer Feature from Libra Savings
promotions.highlight: 💸 Transfer directly from Libra Savings to third-party accounts
promotions.description: Customers can now experience a new feature that allows direct transfers from Libra Savings accounts to third-party accounts. Daily transfer limits have also been increased to up to HKD 1 million for greater convenience.

promotions.title: Insurance Products with 100% Premium Refund
promotions.highlight: 💯 100% premium refund on selected insurance products
promotions.description: Customers can enjoy a 100% premium refund when purchasing selected insurance products through Ant Bank. The bank acts as an agent for YF Life Insurance International Ltd. to distribute life and general insurance products in Hong Kong.

promotions.title: Secure Savings Service (Smart Secure)
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Extra security protection for your bank deposits
promotions.description: Ant Bank has launched the Guarded Deposit service, an anti-fraud measure initiated by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. This service covers Deposit Plus and savings accounts, allowing customers to lock reserved deposits that cannot be transferred through any channels to reduce the risk of fraud.

promotions.title: Insurance Products with up to 3.6% Annualized Rate
promotions.highlight: 📈 Earn up to 3.6% annual rate with insurance products
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers insurance products with up to 3.6% annual rate. These products are provided by YF Life Insurance International Limited and distributed by Ant Bank (Hong Kong) Limited as an insurance agent.

promotions.title: Securities Trading Platform with Low/Zero Commission
promotions.highlight: 🌎 One-stop platform for Hong Kong and US stock trading
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers a one-stop platform for trading Hong Kong and US stocks with banking-level wealth management services. Idle funds can be reallocated at any time, and account opening can be completed in as fast as 3 minutes.
promotions.quota: For Hong Kong residents only (not applicable to mainland or overseas users without Hong Kong resident identity)

promotions.title: Fixed Deposit Early Withdrawal with Zero Penalty Interest
promotions.highlight: 🔓 No penalty for early withdrawal of fixed deposits
promotions.description: Customers can withdraw their entire fixed deposit before maturity without incurring penalty fees. The service offers customizable deposit terms, supports both HKD and USD deposits, and has a low minimum deposit amount of HKD 1.

promotions.title: One-Stop Hong Kong and US Stock Trading Platform
promotions.highlight: 🌍 Access Hong Kong and US stock markets in one platform
promotions.description: A comprehensive trading platform connecting Hong Kong and US stock markets, allowing customers to seize global investment opportunities. The platform offers HK stocks, US stocks, ETFs and other global investment options all in one place.
promotions.quota: Available to Hong Kong residents only
promotions.cost: Free to use (trading fees may apply)

promotions.title: Installment Loan with Fast Approval
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Quick approval and instant fund disbursement
promotions.description: Installment loan service offering flexible loan amounts, competitive low interest rates, simple application process, and fast approval with instant fund disbursement to meet various financial needs.

promotions.title: Personal Loan with Revolving Credit
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Revolving credit with flexible withdrawals
promotions.description: Personal loan with revolving credit facility allowing flexible withdrawals and immediate fund disbursement. Features include easy financial management, simple application, transparent fees, and flexible withdrawals.

promotions.title: New Ant Bank Investment Fund Platform
promotions.highlight: 📈 New investment fund platform with top fund companies
promotions.description: Ant Bank has launched a new investment fund platform in partnership with leading global fund companies. The platform provides a comprehensive, one-stop financial services solution with carefully selected quality funds.
promotions.cost: As low as HKD $1 to start investing

promotions.title: Secured Savings Deposit Protection Service
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Eligible deposits protected up to HKD 800,000 per depositor
promotions.description: Ant Bank (Hong Kong) Limited is a member of the Hong Kong Deposit Protection Scheme. Eligible deposits with the bank are protected by the Deposit Protection Scheme up to a maximum of HKD 800,000 per depositor.
promotions.quota: Maximum protection of HKD 800,000 per depositor

promotions.title: Fast Investment Account Opening
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Open an account in as fast as 3 minutes
promotions.description: Customers can open an Ant Bank account in as little as 3 minutes through a streamlined digital application process. This fast account opening service applies to both banking and investment accounts with no income proof required.

promotions.title: HKD $1 Minimum Fixed Deposit
promotions.highlight: 💵 Start a time deposit with just HKD 1!
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers time deposits with an exceptionally low minimum deposit amount of just HKD 1. This permanent feature makes time deposits accessible to all customers regardless of their savings amount, supporting both HKD and USD currencies.

promotions.title: Ant Bank Global Stock Trading Platform
promotions.highlight: 🌎 One-stop platform for trading Hong Kong and US stocks
promotions.description: Integrated trading platform connecting Hong Kong and US stock markets to capture global investment opportunities. Provides access to Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, ETFs and other global investment options.
promotions.quota: Hong Kong residents only (not applicable to mainland and overseas users without Hong Kong resident status)

promotions.title: Time Deposit with No Early Withdrawal Penalties
promotions.highlight: 🔓 No penalty for early withdrawal of time deposits
promotions.description: Ant Bank offers time deposits with no penalties for early withdrawal. Customers can withdraw their entire time deposit before maturity without incurring any penalty fees, providing flexibility with their savings.

promotions.title: Dual-Account Security Service
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Lock your reserve deposits for enhanced security
promotions.description: Ant Bank has launched the Dual-Account Security Service, an anti-fraud measure promoted by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. This service allows customers to lock their reserve deposits, preventing fund transfers through any channel to reduce the risk of fraudulent transactions.

promotions.title: SGAD (Smart Guarded Account Designation) Service
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Lock your standby deposits with SGAD for extra security
promotions.description: Ant Bank (Hong Kong) has launched the Smart Guarded Account Designation (SGAD) service, an anti-fraud measure introduced by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. This service allows customers to lock standby deposits which cannot be transferred out through any channels, reducing the risk of fraudulent transfers.

promotions.title: Fastee Secure Service
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced security for your deposits with anti-fraud measures!
promotions.description: Ant Bank has launched the Fastee Secure Service, an anti-fraud measure initiated by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority. The service allows customers to lock spare deposits that cannot be transferred out through any channels, reducing the risk of fraud while still earning interest.

promotions.title: Fusion Bank Account Opening - Instant Setup
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Open your account in just 5 minutes with HKID card and mobile number
promotions.description: Fusion Bank offers a streamlined account opening process that takes only 5 minutes to complete. You only need to provide your Hong Kong identity card and mobile phone number to get started. The entire process is completed digitally before your coffee is ready, eliminating the need for lengthy paperwork or branch visits. This is a permanent feature available to all eligible customers aged 18 or above who hold a valid HKID card.
promotions.quota: Hong Kong identity card holder aged 18 or above, non-US person only

promotions.title: Fusion Bank Multi-Currency Transfers - HKD, CNY, USD
promotions.highlight: 🌍 Transfer and exchange HKD, CNY, and USD with real-time rates 24/7
promotions.description: Fusion Bank enables customers to perform local transfers and foreign exchange transactions in Hong Kong dollars, Chinese yuan, and US dollars instantly, anytime and from anywhere. Customers can exchange, spend, and transfer funds locally using real-time exchange rates. Foreign exchange services are available 24 hours a day, except during system maintenance or special circumstances. This is a permanent core feature of Fusion Bank's foreign exchange services with no time limitation or special conditions.

promotions.title: Fusion Bank Deposit Protection Scheme Coverage
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ All eligible deposits protected up to HKD 800,000 per depositor
promotions.description: Fusion Bank is a licensed digital bank in Hong Kong and a member of Hong Kong's Deposit Protection Scheme. All eligible deposits held with Fusion Bank are protected under the scheme with a maximum coverage of HKD 800,000 per customer. This protection is a permanent feature of the bank's membership in the Deposit Protection Scheme with no time limit or special conditions. Customers can deposit with confidence knowing their funds are safeguarded by this government-backed protection mechanism.

promotions.title: Start Savings from HKD 1
promotions.highlight: 💰 Begin your savings journey with as little as HKD 1
promotions.description: Fusion Bank allows customers to open a savings account and start depositing with a minimum amount of just HKD 1. This flexible savings plan is designed to accommodate customers at all financial levels and make banking accessible to everyone. Whether saving for an adventure or a personal milestone, customers can grow their savings at their own pace. This is a permanent feature of Fusion Bank's savings products with no end date or special eligibility conditions.

promotions.title: Global Money Remittance Service
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Send money globally from your smartphone with real-time exchange rates
promotions.description: Fusion Bank offers seamless global money remittance services that allow customers to send funds to any destination worldwide directly from their mobile device. Customers can purchase foreign currency at real-time exchange rates and send it for cashless spending everywhere or transfer it to payment networks. The service connects customers to their family and friends across all corners of the world. This is a permanent feature available to all account holders with no end date or eligibility restrictions beyond basic account requirements.

promotions.title: Fusion Bank Flexible Savings Starting from HKD 1
promotions.highlight: 💰 Start saving with as little as HKD 1
promotions.description: Fusion Bank allows customers to start saving with as little as HKD 1. This flexible savings plan is designed to help customers save for their next adventure or personal milestone. There are no minimum deposit requirements beyond the initial HKD 1, making it accessible for everyone to begin their savings journey. Customers can deposit and withdraw funds at any time through the Fusion Bank mobile application.

promotions.title: First Digital Bank with Foreign Exchange Service
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Send money globally from your smartphone
promotions.description: Fusion Bank provides a global remittance service allowing customers to send money worldwide directly from their smartphone. Customers can buy foreign currency at real-time exchange rates and transfer funds to international destinations or payment networks for cashless spending. This service enables users to stay connected with family and friends across the globe through seamless financial transfers. The foreign exchange service is available 24 hours a day except during system maintenance or special circumstances.

promotions.title: Fusion Flash Monday High-Interest HKD Time Deposit
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Special high-interest HKD time deposit on Mondays
promotions.description: Fusion Bank offers a special high-interest HKD time deposit promotion called 'Flash Monday'. This limited-time offer provides enhanced interest rates for HKD time deposits opened on Mondays through the Fusion Bank platform. Customers can secure better returns on their deposits through this weekly promotion. The exact interest rates and deposit terms may vary each week. Terms and conditions apply to this promotion.

promotions.title: Fusion Bank Savings Interest Plus
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enhanced interest rates on savings accounts
promotions.description: Fusion Bank offers a Savings Interest Plus promotion that provides enhanced interest rates on savings account balances. This special interest rate offer allows customers to earn more on their deposits without locking funds in fixed-term deposits. The promotion is designed to encourage customers to maintain higher balances in their savings accounts. Terms and conditions apply to this offer, which may include minimum balance requirements or other eligibility criteria.

promotions.title: Fusion Bank Foreign Exchange Time Deposit Interest Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💱 Enhanced interest rates for foreign currency time deposits
promotions.description: Fusion Bank offers special interest rewards for customers who exchange currencies and place them in time deposits. This promotion is available for exchanges between HKD, USD, and CNY currencies. Customers can enjoy higher interest rates when they convert their funds and place them in a time deposit with Fusion Bank. There is no limit on the transaction amount for this promotion. Terms and conditions apply to this offer.

promotions.title: 24/7 Foreign Exchange Service
promotions.highlight: 🕒 Exchange currencies anytime with 24-hour foreign exchange service
promotions.description: Fusion Bank provides round-the-clock foreign exchange services available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, except during system maintenance periods or special circumstances. This service allows customers to exchange currencies at their convenience without being restricted by traditional banking hours. The service is available to all Fusion Bank account holders and supports exchanges between various currencies including HKD, CNY, and USD. Exchange rates are subject to market conditions and may fluctuate throughout the day.

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Account Service
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Transfer and manage HKD, CNY and USD from one account
promotions.description: Fusion Bank allows customers to make local transfers in multiple currencies including HKD, CNY, and USD. The service enables easy currency exchange and management from a single account.

promotions.title: Foreign Exchange Time Deposit Interest Rate Boost
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enhanced interest rates for forex time deposits
promotions.description: Customers who exchange foreign currencies can enjoy boosted interest rates on time deposits with Fusion Bank. This offer applies to various currencies including USD, HKD, and RMB with no upper limit on deposit amounts.
promotions.cost: Cost of currency exchange and minimum deposit amount

promotions.title: Foreign Currency Exchange Reward Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💱 Exchange currencies with real-time rates during service hours
promotions.description: Foreign exchange service available Monday to Friday (working days) from 9:00am to 5:00pm. Allows customers to exchange currencies at real-time market rates, though service will be suspended during Black Rainstorm or Typhoon Signal No.8 or above.

promotions.title: Foreign Exchange Rewards Campaign
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Special rewards for foreign currency exchange
promotions.description: Special promotion for customers exchanging currencies with Fusion Bank. The campaign includes benefits for exchanging between HKD, USD, and CNY with no upper limit on transaction amounts.

promotions.title: Fixed Deposit Bonus Interest for Foreign Currency Exchange
promotions.highlight: 💱 Special exchange rates and time deposit bonus interest
promotions.description: Promotional offer for foreign currency exchange featuring bonus interest rates on time deposits. Includes currency exchange between USD, HKD, and RMB with no upper limit on transaction amount.

promotions.title: liviSave Preferential Savings Rate Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn preferential savings rates with no minimum deposit required
promotions.description: liviSave offers customers a preferential savings rate on deposits. There is no minimum deposit requirement to open or maintain a liviSave account. Account opening is completed entirely online through the livi app without the need for complicated documents. This is a permanent savings product feature available to all customers.

promotions.title: liviSave Account with No Fees and No Minimum Deposit
promotions.highlight: 🏦 Open a liviSave account with no fees and no minimum deposit
promotions.description: The liviSave account features no account maintenance fees and no minimum deposit balance requirement. The account is designed to meet both paying and saving needs in one place. Opening a liviSave account is available 100% online, quick, and easy through the livi app at any time.

promotions.title: Instant Transfers with FPS (Faster Payment System)
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Fast and free instant transfers to anyone anytime using FPS
promotions.description: livi provides fast and free instant transfers to any recipient at any time using the Faster Payment System (FPS). Customers can transfer funds instantly without any transfer fees or restrictions on timing. This service is available as a standard feature to all livi account holders.

promotions.title: Pay with livi – QR Payment Service
promotions.highlight: 🛒 Fast and secure QR payments accepted by merchants across Hong Kong
promotions.description: livi offers fast and secure QR code payment functionality accepted by merchants throughout Hong Kong. This payment service allows customers to complete transactions easily and securely at participating merchants. The QR payment service is available to all livi account holders as a standard feature.

promotions.title: livi Rewards Program - Happiness
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Enjoy special rewards and benefits with livi Rewards
promotions.description: livi Rewards offers special benefits and perks to livi bank customers. The program provides various rewards that can be redeemed by customers who use livi's banking services. While specific details of the rewards are not provided, this program appears to be a customer loyalty initiative designed to enhance the banking experience. Customers can likely access and manage these rewards through the livi app.

promotions.title: Universal Voyage Travel Insurance Plan
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Comprehensive travel insurance coverage for your journeys
promotions.description: The Universal Voyage Travel Insurance Plan offers protection during your travels. This insurance product is available to livi bank customers looking for travel coverage. The plan likely includes standard travel insurance benefits such as medical coverage, trip cancellation, lost baggage, and other travel-related protections. Customers can purchase this insurance through the livi app before their trips to ensure they have adequate protection while traveling.

promotions.title: Easy HomeCare Insurance
promotions.highlight: 🏠 Protection for your home and belongings
promotions.description: The Easy HomeCare insurance plan provides coverage for your home and personal belongings. This insurance product is available to livi bank customers who own or rent homes. The plan likely covers risks such as fire, theft, water damage, and other common household perils. Customers can purchase this insurance through the livi app to protect their homes and valuables against unexpected damages or losses.

promotions.title: Pet Care Insurance
promotions.highlight: 🐾 Insurance coverage for your beloved pets
promotions.description: Pet Care insurance offers protection for your pets' health and wellbeing. This insurance product is available to livi bank customers who own pets. The plan likely covers veterinary expenses, accidents, illnesses, and potentially other pet-related emergencies. Customers can purchase this insurance through the livi app to ensure their pets receive necessary medical care without financial strain during unexpected health issues.
promotions.cost: Premium varies based on pet type and coverage

promotions.title: livi Flexi Loan - Personal Loan
promotions.highlight: 💸 Flexible personal loan options for various needs
promotions.description: livi Flexi Loan offers personal loan services with flexible terms and conditions. This loan product is available to eligible livi bank customers who meet the bank's credit requirements. The Flexi Loan appears to be designed with customizable features to meet different financial needs and circumstances. Customers can likely apply for this loan through the livi app and receive personalized loan offers based on their credit profile.

promotions.title: livi Flexi Loan - Balance Transfer
promotions.highlight: 💳 Transfer balances from other loans or credit cards
promotions.description: livi Flexi Loan Balance Transfer allows customers to consolidate debt from other financial institutions. This service is available to eligible livi bank customers who wish to transfer their outstanding balances from other loans or credit cards. The Balance Transfer option likely offers competitive interest rates to help customers manage their debts more effectively. Customers can apply for this service through the livi app and potentially save on interest payments compared to their existing loans.

promotions.title: livi Business SME Financing
promotions.highlight: 💰 Financing solutions for small and medium enterprises
promotions.description: livi Business SME Financing offers loan and credit facilities for small and medium-sized businesses. This financing option is available to eligible SMEs that meet livi bank's credit criteria. The SME financing solution likely includes various funding options such as working capital loans, equipment financing, or business expansion loans. Business owners can apply for these financial solutions through livi's business banking platform to support their company's growth and operational needs.

promotions.title: BOC Chill Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Special card offering unique benefits
promotions.description: The BOC Chill Card offers payment capabilities with special features. This card is available to eligible livi bank customers who apply and meet the qualification criteria. While specific details are not provided, the card likely includes benefits such as rewards, discounts, or special privileges at participating merchants. Customers can apply for this card through the livi app to enjoy its unique features and enhance their spending experience.

promotions.title: BOC Mastercard® Debit Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Mastercard debit card for global acceptance
promotions.description: The BOC Mastercard Debit Card provides global payment capabilities and wide acceptance. This debit card is available to eligible livi bank customers with active accounts. The Mastercard debit card enables customers to make purchases at millions of locations worldwide where Mastercard is accepted, as well as online shopping and ATM withdrawals. Customers can apply for this card through the livi app to access their funds conveniently for everyday spending.

promotions.title: livi QR Cash Withdrawal
promotions.highlight: 💵 Withdraw cash using QR codes for convenience
promotions.description: Access cash withdrawals using QR codes for a convenient banking experience. This service is available to all livi bank customers with an active account. The QR Cash feature allows customers to withdraw money without traditional ATM cards by using QR codes generated in the livi app. This provides a secure and modern alternative to conventional cash withdrawal methods, enhancing customer convenience and accessibility to their funds.

promotions.title: livi Business Account
promotions.highlight: 💼 Business banking solutions for companies
promotions.description: livi Business Account provides banking services tailored for business needs. This account is available to eligible businesses that meet livi bank's requirements. The business account likely includes features such as business transactions, payment processing, and other financial management tools designed for commercial use. Business owners can open and manage these accounts through livi's business banking platform to handle their company's financial operations efficiently.

promotions.title: livi Account Opening - 100% Online Process
promotions.highlight: 📱 Quick and easy 100% online account opening
promotions.description: Open a livi bank account completely online without complicated documents. The process is quick and easy, allowing customers to join anytime, anywhere through the app.

promotions.title: Digital Account Opening in Minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ 100% online account opening - quick and easy
promotions.description: Open a livi account completely online without complicated documents. The process is quick and easy, allowing you to start banking from anywhere at any time through the app.

promotions.title: Tax Deduction for Wang Fuk Court Support Fund Donations
promotions.highlight: 💝 Special tax deduction arrangement for Support Fund donations
promotions.description: Donations made to the Support Fund for Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po through bank transfer with an amount of HK$50,000 or below are eligible for tax deductions without requiring official receipts. Donors need to retain relevant donation records for potential review by the Inland Revenue Department.

promotions.title: liviSave No Minimum Balance
promotions.highlight: 💸 No fees and no minimum deposit requirements
promotions.description: Open a liviSave account without worrying about fees or minimum balance requirements. This account caters to both paying and saving needs, offering complete flexibility for customers.

promotions.title: Money Safe Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Special rewards for keeping your money safe
promotions.description: livi offers 'Money Safe Rewards' (智安存獎賞) program that provides benefits to customers for maintaining security measures. This program rewards customers for practicing safe banking habits.

promotions.title: No Minimum Deposit Requirement
promotions.highlight: 🆓 No fees and no minimum balance requirements
promotions.description: Open and maintain a liviSave account with no minimum deposit requirement and no maintenance fees. This feature makes the account accessible to everyone regardless of their financial situation.

promotions.title: Instant Loan with Interest Rate as Low as 1.18% and up to HKD10,888 Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 💵 Successfully apply for designated Instant Loan and earn up to HKD12,888 cash reward at attractive rates from 1.18%
promotions.description: From now until 31 July 2026, customers who successfully apply for designated Instant Loan products can enjoy up to HKD12,888 cash reward. The application process is simple and personalized via the Mox app from quotation to instant disbursement. Customers must meet the designated loan product requirements to qualify for the cash reward. No specific cap or additional terms are mentioned beyond the stated promotion end date.
promotions.quota: Customers applying for designated Instant Loan products

promotions.title: Xiaomi Shopping Rewards with up to 7% Total Cash Rewards and 0% Instalments
promotions.highlight: 📱 Earn up to 7% total cash rewards (up to 5% extra rebate capped at HKD450 plus 2% unlimited cashback) plus up to 12-month 0% instalments at Xiaomi
promotions.description: New Mox Credit customers can earn up to 7% total cash rewards when shopping at mi.com or any Xiaomi Store using their Mox Credit Card. Specifically, customers receive up to 5% extra cash rebate (capped at HKD450) when hitting the required cumulative spend threshold, plus the standard up to 2% unlimited cashback on all spending. Additionally, customers enjoy up to 12-month 0% interest instalments on their Xiaomi purchases. New customers who sign up with invitation code XM1500MOX earn up to HKD2,150 in cash rewards, with an extra HKD2,150 available as a new customer bonus.

promotions.title: Mox Invest Journey from Scratch – Scratch Cards with Prize Up to HKD8,888
promotions.highlight: 🎰 Complete 5 missions to scratch & win up to HKD8,888 reward: HKD8,000 SOL (Solana) + HKD888 cash
promotions.description: During the promotional period from 16 March 2026 to 15 June 2026, customers can complete any of five simple challenges in the Mox Invest app to receive a Mox Scratch Card and instantly reveal their prize. Finish more missions to multiply chances to win the top prize of HKD8,888 consisting of HKD8,000 worth of SOL (Solana) cryptocurrency plus HKD888 cash reward. Quota is limited on a first-come, first-served basis. Investment involves risks as per Mox Invest Terms and Conditions.

promotions.title: Mox x csl Best-in-Town Exclusive Plan Offer – Up to HKD1,380 Rebates Plus Free NowTV Pass
promotions.highlight: 🤳 Get HKD180 monthly fee rebate plus a free Now TV beIN SPORTS Super Pack 1-Month Pass (valued at HKD188)
promotions.description: Mox x csl offers an exclusive plan promotion where customers can sign up for a new csl plan or renew an existing one with Mox Credit Card autopay setup. Upon completion, customers automatically enjoy an HKD180 monthly fee rebate plus a free Now TV beIN SPORTS Super Pack 1-Month Pass valued at HKD188. This provides both connectivity and entertainment benefits in one integrated offer. The rebate applies monthly, and the free Now TV pass enhances the overall value of the promotion.
promotions.cost: New csl plan or renewal with Mox Card autopay

promotions.title: Mox Travel Pick & Go Insurance – Free Add-on Coverage Promotion
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Apply for Travel Pick & Go insurance and receive 1 FREE add-on coverage (Eggstra Care+)
promotions.description: From 4 March to 31 May 2026, customers applying for Mox Travel Pick & Go insurance receive one free add-on coverage called Eggstra Care+. This complimentary add-on helps safeguard trips from financial stress caused by unexpected events. To qualify, apply for the Travel Pick & Go insurance policy during the promotional period and the free add-on coverage will be automatically included. The promotion provides additional peace of mind for travelers at no extra cost.
promotions.quota: All customers applying during promotion period

promotions.title: Mox MOXTRAVEL Welcome Offer – Earn Up to 28,500 Asia Miles
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Earn up to 28,500 Asia Miles through spending and saving – enough for a round-trip flight to Asia
promotions.description: New customers who enter invitation code 'MOXTRAVEL' to open a Mox account and apply for a Mox Credit Card can earn up to 28,500 Asia Miles through spending and saving activities from now until 30 June 2026. The earned miles are sufficient for a round-trip flight to Asia destinations. To qualify, complete the account opening and credit card application using the specified invitation code during the promotion period. This offer is exclusive to new Mox customers who have not previously held a Mox account.

promotions.title: MOXPAYROLL Invitation Code - Earn up to HKD1,600 for Payroll Customers
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD1,600 cash reward: HKD400 on card approval plus HKD600 monthly for eligible payroll transactions
promotions.description: New customers can open a Mox Account using invitation code 'MOXPAYROLL' by 30 June 2026, and upon Mox Credit Card approval within the following 30 days, earn HKD400. Additionally, accumulate eligible payroll transactions (salary deposits via FPS) in May and June 2026 to earn HKD600 each month, totaling up to HKD1,600 in cash rewards. This offer is only applicable to customers who have not held any Mox Account in their name during the 12 months prior to the onboarding date. The promotion period ends on 30 June 2026.
promotions.quota: New customers only, not previously held Mox Account in past 12 months

promotions.title: Mox Welcome Offer with 'MOXDEPO' Invitation Code – Time Deposit Bonus
promotions.highlight: 💳 Earn HKD2,500 cash reward when you place a Time Deposit of at least HKD250,000
promotions.description: New customers can open a Mox Account using invitation code 'MOXDEPO' by 30 June 2026 and earn HKD2,500 cash reward. To qualify, complete account opening within 15 days of registration, place a Time Deposit of at least HKD250,000 within 7 days of account opening, and maintain the HKD250,000 Time Deposit Account Balance until the end of the Hold Fund Period. This offer is exclusively available to customers who have not held any Mox Account during the 12 months prior to the onboarding date. The cash reward will be credited upon meeting all requirements.
promotions.quota: New customers only, not previously held Mox Account in past 12 months
promotions.cost: Minimum Time Deposit of HKD250,000 required

promotions.title: Mox Spend & Save Double Rewards – 20% Cash Rebate from 5 Merchants Plus Savings Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🎯 Build wealth through daily spending — earn direct stock rewards instead of points via StockBack x ZA Card
promotions.description: ZA Bank's StockBack program permanently allows cardholders to earn direct stock rewards on everyday card spending rather than traditional loyalty points. Customers accumulate stocks through normal spending and build personalized reward packages via daily transactions. This is a core card reward feature with no expiry date and permanent availability to all ZA Card holders.
promotions.quota: All ZA Card holders; no limit

promotions.title: Mox MOXHKT25 Welcome Offer - Up to HKD1,400 Rewards + Mega Football Event Pass Discount
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Earn up to HKD1,400 rewards: 2,000 Clubpoints + HKD1,000 cash reward + 2% Unlimited CashBack
promotions.description: New customers who open a Mox Account by 30 June 2026 using invitation code 'MOXHKT25' and apply for Mox Credit Card can enjoy three reward tiers totaling up to HKD1,400 in benefits. First, receive 2,000 Clubpoints (valued at approximately HKD400) by linking their Mox Card to The Club account and applying for Mox Credit Card. Second, earn an extra HKD1,000 cash reward by spending HKD1,000 in a single transaction at csl Shop, 1O1O Center, or subscribing to HKT service within 30 days of card approval. Third, enjoy unlimited 2% CashBack on all spending with no cap or category limits. The Clubpoint conversion ratio is subject to change at The Club's discretion.
promotions.quota: New customers only, limited quota on first-come, first-served basis
promotions.cost: HKD1,000 spending requirement for HKD1,000 cash reward

promotions.title: Xiaomi Exclusive Offer – Up to 7% Total Cash Rewards with Mox Credit Card
promotions.highlight: 📱 Earn up to 7% total cash rewards at Xiaomi plus 0% instalments, with new customer bonus up to HKD2,150
promotions.description: New Mox Credit Card customers can earn up to HKD2,150 cash bonus when shopping at mi.com or any Xiaomi Store. By hitting the required cumulative spend requirement using your Mox Credit Card, unlock up to 5% extra cash rebate capped at HKD450 plus up to 12-month 0% interest instalments. On top of the standard up to 2% Unlimited CashBack, the total rewards can reach up to 7% cash rewards. New customers should sign up with invitation code 'XM1500MOX' to earn the worth-up-to HKD2,150 in cash rewards during their spending on Xiaomi products.

promotions.title: Mox Invest 0% Fund Subscription Fee (All Fees Waived)

promotions.title: 3-Minute Investment Account Opening for Existing Customers
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open a bank account in as fast as 3 minutes
promotions.description: PADB offers an expedited account opening process that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes for standard applications where no additional documents or information are required. This digital onboarding service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors physically present in Hong Kong. The quick account opening process features no minimum balance requirement.
promotions.quota: Hong Kong residents and visitors physically present in Hong Kong

promotions.title: Discounted Subscription Fee for Bond Funds
promotions.highlight: 🔽 Reduced subscription fees on investment funds
promotions.description: PADB offers discounted subscription fees for various types of funds. Money market funds come with no subscription fees, bond funds are available at a reduced subscription fee of 0.5%, while mixed and equity funds have a competitive subscription fee of 1%. This pricing structure makes investing in funds more accessible and cost-effective compared to traditional channels, which typically charge 2-3% for fund subscriptions.
promotions.cost: Money market funds: Free; Bond funds: 0.5%; Mixed and equity funds: 1%

promotions.title: Global Investment Access Platform
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Access global markets with HK stocks, US stocks, funds and money market funds
promotions.description: PADB provides comprehensive global investment access through its integrated platform, featuring Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, funds, and money market funds. The service allows customers to easily diversify their investments across different asset classes and global markets. Users benefit from a seamless experience switching between banking and investment functions, with all capabilities available in a single account.
promotions.cost: Free platform access; trading fees apply for specific investment products

promotions.title: Banking Services for Hong Kong Visitors
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Banking services available to visitors physically in Hong Kong
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers banking services to visitors who are physically present in Hong Kong. This allows non-residents to access banking services during their stay in the city.
promotions.quota: Only for visitors physically present in Hong Kong

promotions.title: Hong Kong Stock Trading Commission Rate
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Trade Hong Kong stocks with no platform fee
promotions.description: PADB offers Hong Kong stock trading with no platform fees, allowing investors to trade more cost-effectively. The service includes real-time market indices to help investors determine optimal trading timing. Customers only pay a competitive commission of 0.15% with a minimum charge of HKD 50 per transaction.
promotions.cost: 0.15% commission with minimum HKD 50 per trade; no platform fee

promotions.title: Banking Security × Brokerage-Grade Trading Power
promotions.highlight: 🔐 Enjoy bank-level security with professional trading capabilities
promotions.description: PADB combines robust banking security with professional brokerage-grade trading capabilities in a dual-strength investment account. Customers can effortlessly switch between investments and deposits, enabling agile portfolio management in changing market conditions. The service provides diversification options and smooth execution without friction, allowing users to stay ahead of market changes.
promotions.cost: Free account access; trading fees apply for specific investment transactions

promotions.title: Services for Residents and Visitors in Hong Kong
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Banking services available for both HK residents and visitors
promotions.description: Banking services available to both Hong Kong residents and visiting customers who are physically present in Hong Kong. Offers comprehensive banking capabilities for all eligible customers.

promotions.title: Low Minimum Investment for Money Market Funds
promotions.highlight: 💵 Invest in money market funds from just $20 USD
promotions.description: PADB offers USD money market funds with a low entry threshold of just 20 USD. These funds provide a relatively stable investment option with lower volatility and uncertainty compared to other investment products.

promotions.title: Time Deposit Account
promotions.highlight: 💰 Steady and reliable growth with time deposits
promotions.description: Time deposit accounts that support steady and reliable growth. Flexibly arrange your funds to earn interest with both current and time deposit accounts.

promotions.title: Low Minimum Investment Threshold for Money Market Funds
promotions.highlight: 💰 Start investing with as little as HK$100 or US$20
promotions.description: PAObank allows customers to start investing in money market funds with a low minimum threshold of HK$100 for HKD funds or US$20 for USD funds. This makes wealth management products accessible to a wider range of customers.

promotions.title: Time Deposit Growth
promotions.highlight: 💰 Steady and reliable growth through time deposits
promotions.description: PAObank offers time deposit services to help customers achieve steady and reliable growth on their savings. This service provides a secure way to earn interest on funds deposited for a fixed period.

promotions.title: Multiple Insurance Options
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Diverse insurance options including life, savings, motor, home, and travel
promotions.description: PAObank offers a comprehensive range of insurance products including life, savings, motor, home, and travel insurance. Applications can be completed through the bank's mobile app, with personalized advisory services available for wealth and legacy planning.

promotions.title: Low Minimum Fund Subscription
promotions.highlight: 💵 Invest in funds with as little as USD 20
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank allows customers to subscribe to money market funds with a minimum amount as low as USD 20. This low entry barrier makes fund investment accessible to more customers regardless of their investment capital.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Unlimited $0 Fund Subscription and Switching Fees
promotions.highlight: 💰 Unlimited $0 subscription and switching fees on all fund investments
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers unlimited $0 subscription and switching fees on featured funds, allowing customers to flexibly allocate their funds and build diversified passive income streams without incurring transaction fees. This is a permanent feature of the Digital Wealth Advisory and Featured Funds services, with no expiration date or special eligibility conditions beyond being a WeLab Bank customer. Customers can invest and reallocate their portfolios at any time without worrying about additional charges.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Personal Loan 'R-Friend Referral' Campaign
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn HKD 800 cash reward per successful referral, up to HKD 8,000 (10 referrals)
promotions.description: WeLab Bank customers can earn HKD 800 cash reward each time they successfully refer a friend or relative to apply for WeLab Bank Personal Loan using their designated referral code and the referee completes loan drawdown within 7 days of approval. The maximum referral reward is HKD 8,000 during the campaign period (up to 10 successful referrals). Both existing and new WeLab Bank customers can be referees. The referral reward will be credited into the referrer's HKD Core Account on or before 31 July 2026. If the referrer closes their account within one year of receiving the referral reward, WeLab Bank reserves the right to deduct the credited amount or collect it through other means.
promotions.quota: All WeLab Bank customers are eligible; maximum HKD 8,000 per customer during campaign period

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Personal Loan Cash Rebate Up to HKD 23,888
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 23,888 cash rebate on WeLab Bank Personal Loans
promotions.description: Successful WeLab Bank Personal Loan applicants with an approved loan amount of minimum HKD 150,001 and a tenor of 24 months or more can enjoy up to HKD 23,888 cash rebate if the loan is drawn down within 7 days after approval. The cash rebate amount will be credited directly into the borrower's HKD Core Account on or before 31 October 2026. This rebate applies to both WeLab Bank Personal Instalment Loans and WeLab Bank Debt Consolidation Loans. Eligibility is limited to customers who meet the minimum loan amount and tenor requirements during the campaign period.
promotions.quota: New WeLab Bank Personal Loan applicants with minimum loan amount of HKD 150,001 and 24-month tenor
promotions.cost: Minimum approved loan of HKD 150,001 required; 24-month tenor minimum

promotions.title: Investment Fund Cash Rewards - Up to HKD 4,000
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 1,500 cash reward when you invest HKD 100,000 or more in funds
promotions.description: WeLab Bank is offering up to HKD 1,500 cash reward (equivalent to 4.87% one-month annual rate) for eligible customers who participate in the April Investment GO program. To qualify, you must have successfully opened a valid Core Account with WeLab Bank on or before 31 March 2026, maintain your Core Account and Investment Account between 9 April 2026 and 21 April 2026, and subscribe to any fund via Featured Fund Services or GoWealth Digital Wealth Advisory with an aggregate investment amount of not less than HKD 100,000 (or its equivalent) by the cut-off time on 21 April 2026. The cash reward will be credited into your HKD Core Account on or before the specified date. This promotion is open to existing WeLab Bank customers who meet all eligibility criteria during the promotion period.
promotions.quota: Existing WeLab Bank customers only who opened account on or before 31 March 2026

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Tesla Unsecured Loan Referral Reward HKD 800
promotions.highlight: 🚗 Earn HKD 800 cash reward when you refer a friend to apply for Tesla Unsecured Loan
promotions.description: WeLab Bank customers can earn HKD 800 cash reward by successfully referring friends to apply for and drawdown Tesla Unsecured Loan using their referral code. The reward structure mirrors the Personal Loan referral program, allowing customers to earn rewards for each successful referral during the campaign period. The referral reward will be credited to your HKD Core Account on or before 31 July 2026. Both existing and new WeLab Bank customers can be referees, and the loan must be drawn down within 7 days after approval to qualify.
promotions.quota: All WeLab Bank customers; existing or new referee customers

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Global Wallet Competitive Exchange Rates
promotions.highlight: 🌍 Access the best FX rates in town for international transfers and currency exchanges
promotions.description: WeLab Bank leverages AI and technology to offer customers the best foreign exchange rates compared to other retail banks in Hong Kong. This comparison is based on exchange rates collected from 28 retail banks' websites, online banking, or mobile banking platforms as of approximately 2:30 pm on 14 January 2026, excluding banks that do not publish FX rates through these channels. The rates include any fees charged by banks for FX transactions to facilitate a transparent comparison. This is an ongoing product feature available to all WeLab Bank customers with no end date or special eligibility conditions.
