promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card - $0 Foreign Currency Transaction Fee
promotions.highlight: 💳 Global debit card for domestic and international transactions
promotions.description: The WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card is linked to the WeLab Global Wallet and allows customers to make purchases both domestically and internationally. The card enables customers to spend in multiple currencies with competitive exchange rates, avoiding traditional foreign transaction fees that might be charged by other banks. Customers can manage their debit card settings, including security features and spending limits, through the WeLab Bank app. The WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card is designed to provide a seamless spending experience for customers, particularly those who travel frequently or make international purchases online. The card is part of WeLab Bank's suite of products aimed at simplifying global financial management.

promotions.title: Tesla Customer Exclusive Personal Instalment Loan Offer
promotions.highlight: 💼 Flexible personal loans for various financial needs
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Personal Instalment Loan provides customers with flexible financing options for various personal needs. The loan can be used for a wide range of purposes, from home improvements to education expenses or travel. The product features competitive interest rates and flexible repayment terms to suit different customer needs. Applicants can apply through the WeLab Bank app with a streamlined digital application process. During promotional periods, customers may be eligible for cash rebates when meeting specific criteria such as minimum loan amounts and tenor requirements. This loan product is a core offering in WeLab Bank's suite of financing solutions designed to meet customers' diverse financial needs.

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0 4% p.a. Time Deposit for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 💰 Competitive interest rates for time deposits
promotions.description: GoSave 2.0 is WeLab Bank's time deposit product offering competitive interest rates for customers. The service allows customers to lock in funds for a fixed period to earn higher interest compared to regular savings accounts. According to an example in the website, new customers could open two 1-month HKD GoSave 2.0 time deposits with 4% annual interest rate, one with HKD 80,000 and another with HKD 200,000. The combined interest for these deposits would amount to approximately HKD 920.55 (calculated as (HKD 80,000 × 4% ÷ 365 × 30) + (HKD 200,000 × 4% ÷ 365 × 30)). GoSave 2.0 is part of WeLab Bank's suite of savings products designed to help customers maximize their earnings.

promotions.title: WeLab Money Plus Investment Service
promotions.highlight: 💰 Money market fund with returns up to 4.4% in the past year
promotions.description: WeLab Money Plus (also referred to as WeLab 閒智寶) is a money market fund offered through WeLab Bank's Featured Fund Services. It provides returns similar to time deposits but without locking in the term. According to the platform, it has achieved returns of up to 4.4% in the past year. The fund is designed for those seeking liquidity while still earning competitive returns. Instructions submitted before the trading day cut-off time (9:00 AM Hong Kong time) qualify for same-day settlement. The Value US Dollar Money Market Fund B Class (HKD) (Accumulation) specifically showed a one-year return of up to 4.43% and a total return of 10.48% since its establishment on November 22, 2023.
promotions.cost: Minimum investment of HKD 100 or USD 15

promotions.title: Apple Products Subscribe+ Program
promotions.highlight: 🍎 Installment plan specifically for Apple product purchases
promotions.description: The Subscribe+ for Apple Products program (also called Apple 產品好賞分期計劃 in Chinese) is a specialized installment plan offered by WeLab Bank for customers who wish to purchase Apple products. This financing option allows customers to spread the cost of Apple devices over multiple payments, making premium technology more accessible. The program is specifically designed for Apple products and offers competitive payment terms. Customers can apply for this financing through the WeLab Bank app. This installment plan is part of WeLab Bank's partnership with Apple and reflects their strategic collaborations with leading technology companies.

promotions.title: Policy Loan Service
promotions.highlight: 📝 Loans using insurance policies as collateral
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers Policy Loans that allow customers to use their existing insurance policies as collateral to obtain financing. This loan option enables policyholders to access liquidity from their insurance assets without surrendering their policies or losing coverage. The Policy Loan product is designed for customers who have built up cash value in their insurance policies and need access to funds for various purposes. The loan amount is typically based on the cash surrender value of the policy. This financing option is part of WeLab Bank's comprehensive loan offerings, which include personal instalment loans, card debt consolidation loans, and specialized financing solutions.

promotions.title: Money Safe Feature
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced security features for your funds
promotions.description: Money Safe (智安存 in Chinese) is a security feature offered by WeLab Bank designed to provide enhanced protection for customers' funds. This feature helps safeguard customer deposits against unauthorized access and transactions. Money Safe is part of WeLab Bank's commitment to providing secure banking services in the digital environment. The service likely includes various security protocols and measures to ensure that customers' funds remain protected. This security feature complements WeLab Bank's digital-first approach to banking, providing customers with peace of mind while conducting their financial activities through the WeLab Bank app.

promotions.title: Learn Now Pay Later Program
promotions.highlight: 📚 Flexible financing option for educational expenses
promotions.description: The Learn Now Pay Later Program is a financing solution offered by WeLab Bank that allows customers to pay for educational expenses over time. This program enables customers to access educational opportunities immediately while spreading the cost over a more manageable payment schedule. The financing option is designed to make education more accessible by reducing the upfront financial burden. Customers can apply for this loan program through the WeLab Bank app. The Learn Now Pay Later Program is part of WeLab Bank's diverse loan offerings, which include personal instalment loans, card debt consolidation loans, and other specialized financing options.

promotions.title: Card Debt Consolidation Loan
promotions.highlight: 💳 Consolidate high-interest credit card debt into a single loan
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a Card Debt Consolidation Loan that helps customers combine multiple high-interest credit card debts into a single, potentially lower-interest loan. This product is designed to simplify debt management by consolidating various credit card balances into one monthly payment, potentially at a lower interest rate. The consolidation can help customers save on interest payments and better manage their finances with a clearer repayment schedule. Customers can apply for this loan through the WeLab Bank app, with the potential to qualify for cash rebates when meeting certain criteria during promotional periods. This loan product is part of WeLab Bank's loan offerings aimed at helping customers better manage their financial obligations.

promotions.title: Featured Funds Services with Over 170 Funds
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Access to over 170 mutual funds from top global fund houses
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Featured Funds Service provides access to more than 170 mutual funds from top global fund houses. The service features a user-friendly interface that showcases popular investment ideas, allowing customers to invest in mutual funds, dividend funds, bond funds, and more with just one click. Investment can start from as low as HKD 100 or USD 15, making fund investment more accessible. The service displays various fund categories like high-yield funds with annual returns up to 7.6%, global income funds with returns up to 6.4%, and conservative dividend funds with returns up to 4.0%, among others. This ongoing service allows customers to easily track market trends and make informed investment decisions.
promotions.cost: 0.1% monthly platform fee on total fund holdings

promotions.title: GoWealth Digital Wealth Advisory
promotions.highlight: 🤖 AI-powered investment advisory service with personalized portfolio recommendations
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Digital Wealth Advisory Service, branded as 'GoWealth', provides personalized investment portfolio recommendations based on individual investment goals and personal situations. The service allows customers to set investment objectives, including investment period and one-time or monthly investment amounts. The system then generates tailored portfolio recommendations. After accepting the advice, the system executes the initial investment and sets up automatic monthly investments according to the customer's specifications. The service includes various notifications about investment progress, though these are not investment advice. Customers can monitor progress and adjust goals as needed through the WeLab Bank app.
promotions.cost: 0.1% monthly platform fee on total fund holdings

promotions.title: Quick Account Opening Service
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open a bank account in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a quick account opening service that allows new customers to open a bank account in as little as 2 minutes. This digital onboarding process enables customers to quickly access WeLab's banking services, including investments, without the need to visit a physical branch. After completing the account opening process, customers can immediately begin using their Core Account and activate additional services like the Investment Account. The service is designed to make banking more accessible and convenient through digital channels. Actual account opening time may vary depending on different factors.

promotions.title: Smart Finance with AI Technology
promotions.highlight: 🤖 Highly personalized banking experience powered by Generative AI and AI Agents
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a smart banking experience powered by AI technology to help customers grow their wealth. The bank has established an AI-first strategic partnership with Google to apply artificial intelligence across operations, product design, and marketing. This technology allows WeLab Bank to provide highly personalized financial services for savings, loans, and investments. Customers can manage global debit cards, international transfers, and access loans all through one app, freeing up their time for other priorities.

promotions.title: AI-First Digital Banking Services
promotions.highlight: 🤖 Highly personalized customer experiences using Generative AI and AI Agents
promotions.description: WeLab Bank provides AI-powered banking services through its strategic partnership with Google, applying artificial intelligence across operations, product design, and marketing. This service offers a personalized banking experience tailored to individual customer needs and preferences. Customers can access intelligent financial tools for savings, loans, and investments designed to help them save and earn more efficiently. This always-on AI-first approach represents WeLab's core commitment to delivering smarter banking.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Digital Wealth Advisory Service
promotions.highlight: 🤖 AI-powered personalized investment portfolio management
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's GoWealth Digital Wealth Advisory is a permanent service that offers personalized investment portfolio recommendations using AI technology in partnership with Allianz Global Investors. Customers can set investment goals including investment period and contribution amounts, and the system provides tailored portfolio recommendations. After accepting the recommendation, the system will make the initial investment and continue with automated monthly investments based on the customer's settings. The service provides ongoing notifications about investment progress and allows customers to monitor and adjust their goals as needed. This is not a discretionary asset management service, and the recommendations do not guarantee investment outcomes.
promotions.cost: 0.1% monthly platform fee on fund holdings

promotions.title: ZA Bank Fund Trading – 0% Subscription Fees on ALL Funds (No Cap)
promotions.highlight: 💵 Invest in all funds with 0% subscription fees — no caps, all your money goes into the market
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers 0% subscription fees on all funds with no caps or limits, a permanent product feature available to all users. This means investors can deploy 100% of their invested capital directly into funds without losing any amount to subscription charges. Users can access a wide range of funds through the ZA Bank investment platform and enjoy full transparency in their investment costs.

promotions.title: ZA Card - StockBack Direct Stock Rewards (Get shares instead of points)
promotions.highlight: 📊 Earn actual stocks instead of points with every ZA Card purchase — Hong Kong's first StockBack card
promotions.description: ZA Card features Hong Kong's first StockBack reward program, a permanent product feature allowing cardholders to accumulate and own actual stocks through everyday spending. Instead of earning traditional reward points, users receive stock rewards that can be converted to real shareholdings. This replaces traditional cash-back or points-based rewards with direct stock ownership opportunities, enabling users to build a diversified portfolio through daily card usage.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Multi-Currency Savings Account (0% Forex Conversion Spread)

The account includes flexible asset allocation through both savings and time deposits, with 24/7 currency exchange capability at customer-selected rates to seize market opportunities and grow wealth. This is a core banking product available to all customers with no expiry date or special conditions.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank savings account holders; no limit

promotions.title: ZA Bank High-Interest Savings Pot (Deposit and withdraw anytime, zero fees)

promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a dedicated savings pot product as a permanent feature, designed for users to save with competitive interest rates while maintaining full liquidity. Users can deposit and withdraw anytime with zero fees, making it a flexible savings tool with no lock-in periods or surprise charges. Interest rates are set by the bank and updated periodically to remain competitive.

promotions.highlight: 🪙 Trade crypto 24/7 directly with your HKD or USD deposits; new customers get $0 platform fee for 90 days

New customers (those opening a crypto trading account) enjoy $0 platform fees for the first 90 days after account opening, after which standard platform fees apply. This allows users to access crypto markets anytime without traditional banking hour restrictions.

promotions.description: ZA Card pioneered customization in Hong Kong by allowing cardholders to select the last 6 digits of their own card number, a permanent card feature that adds personalization and memorability. This unique feature was the first of its kind in the Hong Kong market and remains a standard benefit of the ZA Card product.

promotions.title: ZA Card – No Annual Fees, No Hidden Fees, Digital & Physical Options
promotions.highlight: 💳 ZA Card charges zero annual fees and zero hidden fees — a Visa debit card with no surprises
promotions.description: ZA Card is offered with zero annual fees and zero hidden fees, a permanent product feature that makes it a transparent, truly free-to-use Visa debit card. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay for convenient mobile payments and provides users with a no-cost way to access all card benefits including StockBack rewards and PowerDraw entries.

promotions.title: ZA Card - PowerDraw Lottery (Win up to 200% rebate + HKD 1 million prize pool)
promotions.highlight: 🎰 Win up to 200% rebate + share in HKD 1 million prize pool via PowerDraw when you spend with ZA Card
promotions.description: ZA Card's PowerDraw program is an ongoing lottery feature where cardholders earn entries through spending and have the chance to win up to 200% rebate rewards on eligible transactions. Additionally, participants can earn MillionTix which provide a chance to share in a total HKD 1 million prize pool. This replaces traditional fixed rewards with a gamified lottery system, allowing users to potentially win substantially more than standard cashback or rebates.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Stock Trading – 0% Brokerage, 0% Custody Fees, From HKD 18 Platform Fee
promotions.highlight: 📈 Trade stocks with 0% brokerage and 0% custody fees; platform fee as low as USD 1.99 / HKD 18 per trade
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers zero brokerage fees and zero custody fees on all stock trades, a permanent feature of their investment platform. The only cost is a minimal platform fee of USD 1.99 or HKD 18 per transaction, making it one of the most cost-effective stock trading solutions available. This applies to both US stocks and HK stocks available on the platform.
promotions.cost: Platform fee: USD 1.99 / HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.highlight: ⚡ Free instant FPS transfers, card payments, tax payments, and scan-to-pay all in one app
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides permanently free instant FPS (Faster Payment System) transfers for all customers with no end date or expiry condition. The service includes free instant transfers between ZA Bank customers, card payments, tax payments, and scan-to-pay functionality all integrated into a single mobile app. Customers can receive HKD and CNY using just their mobile phone number via FPS. Additional convenience features include a Frequent Payee section for quick repeated transfers and group Lai See distribution with one tap requiring no individual recipient entry.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank customers; no limit

promotions.title: ZA Bank Referral Program - MGM Activity with Account Opening Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Earn up to HKD 900 when you refer friends to take out a ZA Bank loan
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers rewards for customers who successfully refer friends to apply for and take out loans. Referrers can earn up to HKD 900 in rewards when their referred friends complete loan applications and meet the program's conditions. This referral program incentivizes both existing and new customers to promote ZA Bank's lending products to their network.

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary Campaign – Up to HKD 60,000 StockBack Grand Draw
promotions.highlight: 🎯 Earn up to HKD 60,000 in StockBack stock rewards plus up to 12% stock rebate on coffee shop spending
promotions.description: ZA Bank's 6th Anniversary Campaign ran from 1 April to 21 April 2026 and offered multiple ways to earn StockBack stock rewards. All users could win up to HKD 60,000 by simply logging into the app, with users whose age ends in '6' (e.g., 26, 36) receiving double chances to win. Cardholders using StockBack x ZA Card at local coffee merchants earned 6% stock rebate on qualifying transactions over HKD 10, or 12% at specified partner coffee merchants, capped at HKD 50 total in combined rebates per participant. Users could also earn StockBack through ZA Quest tasks, the StockBack x ZA Card reward plan, and the 'Stock Lucky Draw'. Top 60 users accumulating the most StockBack in each of 3 campaign phases (1–7 Apr, 8–14 Apr, 15–21 Apr) won a metal StockBack x ZA Card valued at HKD 1,000; ranks 61–1,000 received early access to the physical card. All stock rewards must be converted to actual shares within 48 hours or they expire and are not re-issued.
promotions.quota: All users eligible; top 1,000 per phase for leaderboard rewards
promotions.cost: Free to participate in lottery; minimum HKD 10 spend for coffee rebate

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary StockBack Leaderboard Rewards - Metal Card and Priority Card Access
promotions.highlight: 🏆 Top 60 weekly leaderboard users win a StockBack x ZA Card metal card (value HKD 1,000); ranks 61–1,000 receive early physical card access
promotions.description: As part of ZA Bank's 6th anniversary promotion running from 1 Apr 2026 to 21 Apr 2026, a leaderboard ranking system awards prizes to top-performing StockBack users across three phases: Phase 1 (1–7 Apr), Phase 2 (8–14 Apr), and Phase 3 (15–21 Apr). StockBack score accumulates through completing designated ZA Quest tasks and selecting stocks, making purchases with ZA Card via the StockBack rebate program and selecting stocks, or obtaining specified stock exchange vouchers through the stock lottery. The top 1,000 users by cumulative StockBack score each phase are ranked: positions 1–60 receive a StockBack x ZA Card metal card worth HKD 1,000; positions 61–1,000 receive priority access to experience the physical StockBack x ZA Card. Each customer can receive a maximum of one (1) leaderboard reward across the entire promotion period. Participants must hold a valid ZA Card and investment account. Rewards are credited according to promotion terms.
promotions.quota: Top 1,000 per phase; maximum one reward per customer across full promotion

The platform enables flexible asset allocation with both savings and time deposits, and users can exchange currencies 24/7 at their preferred rates, allowing them to seize market opportunities and manage global wealth. This is a core, permanent product feature with no end date or special conditions.

promotions.description: ZA Bank provides global transfer services as a permanent feature, allowing users to send money internationally to over 140 countries and regions. promotions.title: ZA Bank 12% Coffee Shop Stock Rebate (Designated Merchants) - April 2026
promotions.highlight: ☕ Earn 12% stock rebate on ZA Card purchases at designated premium coffee merchants (minimum HKD 10)
promotions.description: ZA Bank's 6th anniversary promotion includes a 12% stock rebate offer for qualifying purchases at designated premium coffee merchants from 1 Apr 2026 to 21 Apr 2026. Customers using ZA Card to make eligible transactions (excluding Alipay and WeChat Pay payments) of HKD 10 or more at specified coffee shops earn 12% in stock rebate rewards. The combined cap across both 6% and 12% coffee rebates is HKD 50 per customer throughout the promotion period. When a single transaction qualifies for both 6% and 12% rebate conditions, the customer receives the higher 12% rate. Stock rebates are distributed as StockBack rewards and must be selected within 48 hours of receipt or they become invalid and forfeited. Detailed list of designated coffee merchants is available in the promotion materials. The promotion is subject to full terms and conditions.

promotions.title: Global Transfers to Over 140+ Countries and Regions (Permanent BAU)

promotions.description: ZA Bank provides 24/7 customer service and support as a permanent banking feature, ensuring users can access help anytime regardless of the time of day or day of the week. The bank maintains dedicated support channels including phone lines and live chat to assist with account inquiries, transactions, and technical issues.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Free Instant FPS Transfers (No fees for domestic transfers)
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Free instant FPS transfers to any HK phone number; no fees ever
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers free Instant FPS (Faster Payment System) transfers as a permanent banking feature, allowing users to send money instantly to any Hong Kong phone number at no cost. Users can add frequent payees for quick and easy future transfers, and the app supports Group Lai See distribution (for Lunar New Year red envelopes) with a single tap, no need to enter each recipient individually. This replaces traditional bank transfer fees with a zero-cost model.

promotions.title: ZA Bank - Over 1 Million Users and 4.8/5 App Store Rating
promotions.highlight: ⭐ Trusted by over 1 million users with 4.8/5 rating on App Store
promotions.description: ZA Bank's scale and user satisfaction are permanent features reflecting the bank's market position as Hong Kong's No.1 digital bank. Since official launch in March 2020, the bank has accumulated over 1 million users and maintains a 4.8/5 star rating on the App Store, reflecting consistent user trust and satisfaction. This scale and reputation represent core strengths of the platform rather than time-limited promotions.

promotions.title: The Weeknd Priority Booking - Exclusive Event Access with ZA Card
promotions.highlight: 🎤 Get priority booking access to The Weeknd events with your ZA Card
promotions.description: ZA Card holders receive exclusive priority booking access to The Weeknd concert or event tickets. This perk allows cardholders to reserve tickets before general public sales.

promotions.title: ZA Bank New Customer Welcome Bonus - HKD 1,000 Cashback with Promo Code ZADT88
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn HKD 1,000 spending cashback when you open an account with promo code ZADT88
promotions.description: New customers who successfully open an account using the promotional code 'ZADT88' and complete specified conditions can receive HKD 1,000 in cashback rewards. promotions.title: New Customer HKD 2,026 Reward Package and 2.5% StockBack
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Enjoy year-round travel discounts and exclusive offers with your ZA Card
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers year-round travel-related promotions and discounts to ZA Card holders. The specific merchant partners, discount percentages, and eligibility criteria are detailed in the full promotion terms.

promotions.title: 24/7 Digital Banking Services
promotions.highlight: 🕐 Banking services available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with online and live chat support
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides round-the-clock digital banking services available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Customers can manage their accounts, investments, and payments anytime. The bank offers 24/7 customer service support including online live chat and phone support to assist with any banking needs.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Account Opening - 2 Minutes with Zero Deposit Requirement
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Open a ZA Bank account in as fast as 2 minutes online with zero minimum deposit
promotions.description: Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong can open a ZA Bank savings account online in as fast as 2 minutes without any minimum deposit requirement. The rapid account opening process eliminates traditional banking barriers and allows users to begin banking immediately. This permanent product feature reflects ZA Bank's positioning as a modern, user-friendly digital bank. No deposit is required to activate or maintain the account.
promotions.quota: HK residents and visitors in Hong Kong

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary Coffee Promotion - 6% Stock Rebate
promotions.highlight: ☕ Earn 6% stock rebate on coffee shop purchases with ZA Card
promotions.description: During the 6th Anniversary campaign, ZA Card users earn 6% stock rebate on all qualifying purchases at local coffee merchant categories (excluding Alipay and WeChat Pay transactions) of HKD 10 or more. The rebate is applied as stock rewards to the user's account based on the transaction amount. The 6% rebate is capped at HKD 50 combined with the 12% promotion rebate per customer during the promotion period. Users must complete stock selection within 48 hours or the reward expires. A valid ZA Card and active investment account are required to receive the reward.
promotions.quota: All ZA Card holders; combined cap of HKD 50 with other rebate promotions

promotions.title: ZA Bank High-Interest Savings Pots - Zero Fees
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn high interest on savings with dedicated pots - deposit and withdraw anytime with zero fees
promotions.description: ZA Bank's dedicated savings pots feature provides high-interest earnings on deposits with zero withdrawal fees or deposit restrictions. Users can create multiple savings pots for different financial goals and manage them independently. Deposits and withdrawals are available anytime without penalties, making the savings product highly flexible. This is a permanent savings account feature designed to help users grow their wealth without traditional banking constraints.

promotions.title: ZA Bank StockBack Rewards Program - Earn Free Stocks from Purchases
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Earn free stocks as rewards from your daily ZA Card spending
promotions.description: ZA Bank's StockBack program allows users to earn free stock shares based on their daily spending using the ZA Card, rather than just accumulating points. Users accumulate StockBack opportunities through spending and can choose from available stocks to receive as rewards. This is a permanent feature of the ZA Card product that provides users with an alternative rewards system focused on stock accumulation. The reward stock shares are based on the spending amount, with standard rates of 1% rebate applying to qualifying transactions.

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary Coffee Promotion - 6% StockBack (Apr 2026)
promotions.highlight: ☕ Earn 6% stock rebates on all local coffee merchant purchases with ZA Card
promotions.description: Customers using ZA Card to pay at local coffee merchant category merchants receive 6% stock rebates on qualifying transactions of HKD 10 or more (excluding Alipay and WeChat Pay transactions). The combined cap for 6% and 12% rebates is HKD 50 per customer during the campaign period. If a single transaction qualifies for both 6% and 12% rebates, the customer receives the higher 12% rate automatically.
promotions.quota: Combined HKD 50 cap on 6% and 12% rebates per customer

promotions.title: ZA Bank Cryptocurrency Trading - 24/7 with HKD/USD Deposits

promotions.description: ZA Bank enables round-the-clock cryptocurrency trading 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, with direct trading capability using HKD or USD deposits from customer accounts. This is a permanent investment platform feature available to all customers with active crypto trading services and no promotional end date.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Year-Round Travel Offers
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Exclusive year-round travel discounts and offers throughout the year
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides customers with continuous year-round travel promotions, discounts, and special offers on flights, hotels, and travel-related services. Specific offers and eligibility criteria vary by promotion period.

promotions.title: New Customer Welcome Reward and StockBack Bonus
promotions.highlight: 🆕 New users receive HKD 200 in stock rewards upon account opening
promotions.description: New users opening a ZA Bank account can receive HKD 200 in stock rewards as part of ZA Bank's new customer welcome offer. After successfully opening an account, new customers will receive StockBack rewards that can be used to select stocks through the StockBack machine in the ZA Bank app. Recipients must select their preferred stocks within 48 hours of receiving the reward and must have a valid ZA Card and investment account to receive the stocks. This promotion is designed to introduce new customers to ZA Bank's investment features while providing an immediate reward upon joining. The offer appears to be part of ZA Bank's broader StockBack program that rewards users with fractional shares of stocks.
promotions.quota: New customers only - never had a ZA Bank account or product before
promotions.cost: Free - no minimum deposit or spending required

promotions.title: Instant Loan Approval in as Fast as 90 Seconds

promotions.description: ZA Bank offers flexible loans with approval results available in as fast as 90 seconds for new customers. The service features a simple application process with loan amounts of up to HKD 1,000,000 and annualized percentage rates as low as 1.30%. ZA Bank provides all-rounded loan solutions including Instalment Loans, Card Statement Instalment Plans, and Debt Consolidation Programs to meet different financial needs. The bank regularly introduces market-beating loan offers to help customers reduce their borrowing costs further.
promotions.cost: Interest rates from 1.30% APR depending on credit assessment

promotions.title: ZA Digital Insurance - Application in as Fast as 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured in as fast as 3 minutes via your smartphone
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a smart insurance service that allows customers to get insured in as fast as 3 minutes through their smartphone. The service provides comprehensive coverage options including life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) plans. The entire process is fully digital, enabling customers to apply for insurance plans or file claims easily without paperwork. As a one-stop shop, ZA Bank aims to meet all insurance needs through this convenient and efficient digital insurance service.
promotions.quota: Available to eligible ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Card Statement Instalment Plan with Cash Reward up to HKD 2,000
promotions.highlight: 💵 Get up to HKD 2,000 cash reward with Card Statement Instalment Plan
promotions.description: Apply for ZA Bank's Credit Card Statement Instalment Plan using the promo code [SURPRISE] to earn a cash reward of up to HKD 2,000. The reward amount depends on your loan amount: HKD 588 for loans between HKD 200,000-399,999, HKD 688 for HKD 400,000-799,999, and HKD 2,000 for loans of HKD 800,000 or more. You must choose a repayment period of 18 months or more to qualify. The cash reward will be credited after the 7-day cooling period is completed.
promotions.quota: All eligible applicants who meet the loan amount requirements
promotions.cost: Minimum loan amount of HKD 200,000 with 18+ month repayment period

promotions.title: Zero Deposit Requirement for Account Opening
promotions.highlight: 💰 No minimum deposit required to open an account
promotions.description: ZA Bank allows customers to open accounts with no minimum deposit requirement. This feature is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong who can open an account online. The zero deposit requirement removes financial barriers to banking services, making them more accessible to everyone. Customers can open and maintain their accounts without worrying about maintaining a minimum balance, and can start using ZA Bank's services immediately after account opening.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Stock PowerDraw Promotion
promotions.highlight: 🎯 Get a chance to win free stocks with each stock purchase
promotions.description: Earn a Stock PowerDraw chance with every stock purchase transaction during the promotion period. Each PowerDraw chance is valid for 24 hours from issuance and allows you to win Designated Stock Redemption Coupons for stocks ranked in the top 100 by market value in the US stock market. To qualify, the platform fee must be at least USD 2 for US stocks purchases or HKD 20 for HK stocks purchases. You must use the ZA Bank App version 3.8.9 or above to participate in this promotion.
promotions.quota: Available to all customers who make qualified stock purchases
promotions.cost: Minimum platform fee of USD 2 for US stocks or HKD 20 for HK stocks per transaction

promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy 20% p.a. interest rate on 7-day HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New customers who open a ZA Bank account using a referral code and meet the deposit condition can receive a +19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD new funds time deposit interest rate booster coupon. The deposit condition requires making a single deposit of at least HKD 1,000 from a non-ZA Bank account within 14 days of account opening. The coupon can be applied to new funds up to HKD 20,000. The booster coupon must be claimed from ZA Quest within 7 days of meeting the condition and is valid for 7 days after claiming.

promotions.title: New Account Bonus - Fund Holding Rebate Vouchers
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enjoy 2.5% stock rebate on card spending for new customers
promotions.description: New customers who open a ZA Bank account using a referral code during the promotion period can enjoy a 2.5% stock rebate through the StockBack x ZA Card program. This increased rebate rate combines the standard 1.5% rebate with an additional 1% bonus for new users. To qualify, new customers must choose the StockBack x ZA Card reward plan and make qualifying purchases with their ZA Card. Each eligible transaction gives you a chance to select stocks from the StockBack machine to receive as a reward worth 2.5% of your transaction amount.

promotions.title: Credit Card Statement Instalment Program 90-Second Approval
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Get preliminary loan approval results in just 90 seconds
promotions.description: Experience lightning-fast loan approval with ZA Bank's Credit Card Statement Instalment Program. New users can receive preliminary approval results in just 90 seconds after application, eliminating the anxiety of waiting for loan decisions. This feature allows you to quickly know if you qualify for the program, helping you plan your debt consolidation strategy more efficiently. While the preliminary approval is provided rapidly, you'll still need to submit relevant documents for final approval. For existing ZA Bank customers, the process is even faster, with preliminary approval results available in as little as 30 seconds after logging into the ZA Bank App.
promotions.cost: Free feature of the application process

promotions.title: ZA Card Statement Instalment Plan with Promotion Code SURPRISE
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 2,000 cash reward when clearing credit card bills
promotions.description: Apply for ZA Bank's Credit Card Statement Instalment Program with promotion code 'SURPRISE' and receive cash rewards of up to HKD 2,000. This offer is valid for both new and existing customers who successfully apply and drawdown a credit card statement instalment plan with a minimum 18-month repayment period. The reward amount varies based on loan amount: HKD 588 for loans between HKD 200,000-399,999, HKD 688 for loans between HKD 400,000-799,999, and HKD 2,000 for loans of HKD 800,000 or above. The cash reward will be credited after completing the 7-day cooling-off period.
promotions.cost: Minimum loan amount of HKD 200,000 with 18+ month repayment period

promotions.title: ZA Card Statement Instalment Program 30-Day Deferred Repayment
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Start repayments 30 days after successful application
promotions.description: Enjoy 30 days of breathing room before your first repayment with ZA Bank's Credit Card Statement Instalment Program. After successfully drawing down your credit card statement instalment, your first repayment will begin 30 days later, giving you a full month to organize your finances. The repayment date for your instalment will be the same as your drawdown date, so if you draw down on the 1st of the month, your repayments will always be due on the 1st of subsequent months. This feature provides additional flexibility for borrowers looking to manage their credit card debt through ZA Bank's instalment program.

promotions.title: ZA Card Statement Instalment Program High Loan Limits

promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a Visa debit card with no annual fees and no hidden charges. This card is directly linked to your ZA Bank account, allowing for seamless management of spending. As a permanent feature with no end date or special eligibility requirements, the no-fee structure makes this card accessible to all ZA Bank customers without any ongoing costs, providing a cost-effective payment solution for everyday use.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary StockBack Leaderboard Metal Card
promotions.highlight: 🏆 Win a StockBack x ZA Card metal card worth HKD 1,000
promotions.description: During ZA Bank's 6th anniversary campaign, participate in the StockBack leaderboard competition for a chance to win an exclusive StockBack x ZA Card metal card valued at HKD 1,000. The competition runs in three phases (April 1-7, 8-14, and 15-21), with points earned by completing ZA Quest tasks, using ZA Card with StockBack, and participating in stock draws. The top 60 participants in each phase will receive the metal card. Each participant can win the leaderboard reward only once during the entire promotion period. This is an exclusive opportunity to obtain a premium version of the standard ZA Card.
promotions.cost: Active participation in StockBack activities required

promotions.title: ZA Card PowerDraw Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💰 Win up to 200% cashback through PowerDraw when using ZA Card
promotions.description: Use your ZA Card for everyday purchases and get a chance to participate in PowerDraw, where you can win up to a 200% rebate on your spending. The PowerDraw is a gamified reward system that adds an exciting element to your regular card usage.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Card users

promotions.title: ZA Card Statement Instalment Program Long Repayment Period
promotions.highlight: ⏳ Extended repayment periods up to 72 months
promotions.description: Manage your credit card debt with greater flexibility through ZA Bank's extended repayment periods. The Credit Card Statement Instalment Program offers repayment terms of up to 72 months (6 years), allowing you to spread out your payments over a longer period for smaller monthly installments. This feature is designed with your loan needs in mind, making debt repayment more comfortable and sustainable for your budget. The longer repayment window can significantly reduce monthly payment amounts, though total interest paid may be higher over the extended term. This option is particularly valuable for those consolidating larger credit card debts who prefer smaller, more manageable monthly payments.

promotions.title: Flexible Savings with High-Interest Rates
promotions.highlight: 💰 Dedicated savings pot with competitive interest rates
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a dedicated savings pot designed for customers' needs, providing competitive high-interest rates on deposits. This savings feature allows users to deposit and withdraw funds at any time with zero fees, combining the flexibility of a current account with the higher interest rates typically associated with time deposits. The service is available to all ZA Bank account holders and forms part of their comprehensive deposit offerings. This high-interest savings option is a permanent feature of ZA Bank's product range, helping customers grow their wealth more effectively than traditional low-interest savings accounts.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Group Lai See Feature
promotions.highlight: 🧧 Send digital red packets to multiple recipients with one tap
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a convenient Group Lai See feature that allows users to send digital red packets to multiple recipients with just one tap. The service is integrated with the FPS transfer system, enabling instant delivery of funds to recipients using just their mobile phone numbers. Group Lai See is available to all ZA Bank account holders at no additional cost. Users can access this feature directly from the ZA Bank app's transfer section, making it simple to distribute monetary gifts to friends and family.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: Zero-Fee Visa Debit Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay, providing a truly free banking card option for all users.

promotions.title: ZA Bank HKD 20% p.a. 7-Day Time Deposit for New Referred Customers
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enjoy 20% p.a. interest on 7-day HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers referred by existing users can receive two 19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest boost coupons (plus base rate for total 20% p.a.). The first coupon is awarded when depositing ≥ HKD 1,000 within 14 days of account opening, valid for deposits up to HKD 20,000. A second coupon is granted when maintaining HKD 1,000 balance across deposits, funds and stocks, valid for deposits up to HKD 100,000.
promotions.quota: New customers who open accounts with referral codes during the promotion period
promotions.cost: Must deposit ≥ HKD 1,000 for first coupon; must maintain combined balance of HKD 1,000 across deposits, funds and stocks for second coupon

promotions.title: ZA Card StockBack 6th Anniversary 6% Cashback on Coffee
promotions.highlight: ☕ Get 6% stock rebates at all coffee merchants
promotions.description: During ZA Bank's 6th anniversary celebration, customers could earn 6% StockBack rewards when spending at any local coffee merchant using their ZA Card. Qualifying transactions needed to be at least HKD 10 and made directly with the card (not through Alipay or WeChat Pay). The reward cap for special coffee merchant rebates was HKD 50 per user during the promotion period.
promotions.quota: All ZA Card holders; maximum combined special rebates capped at HKD 50 per user
promotions.cost: Minimum spending of HKD 10 per transaction required

promotions.title: ZA Bank 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Round-the-clock customer support every day
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides 24/7 customer service for all users, ensuring assistance is available at any time of day. This always-on support system allows customers to resolve issues, ask questions, and receive guidance regardless of time constraints. The service is part of ZA Bank's commitment to convenient digital banking that overcomes traditional banking limitations.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank Refer to Take Out a Loan Program
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 900 for referring friends to ZA Bank loans
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can earn rewards up to HKD 900 by referring friends to apply for loans with ZA Bank. The referral program provides cash incentives when referred friends successfully obtain loan products. Reward amounts vary based on the loan type and amount approved for the referred friend.
promotions.quota: Available to all existing ZA Bank customers
promotions.cost: Free to participate; referred friends must complete loan application and approval process

promotions.title: Wise Express Remittance Service
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Fast international transfers powered by Wise
promotions.description: ZA Bank has partnered with Wise to offer express remittance services for HKD payments, providing faster international transfers than traditional methods. This service enables customers to send money internationally with competitive exchange rates and transparent fee structures. It complements ZA Bank's suite of global transfer options, including SWIFT transfers to over 140 countries.
promotions.cost: Fees vary by destination and amount

promotions.title: ZA Bank Insurance Application in as Fast as 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured via smartphone in as little as 3 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a fully digital insurance application process that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes via smartphone. Options include life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) with a simplified claims process.

promotions.title: 24x7 Currency Exchange
promotions.highlight: ⏰ Exchange currencies anytime with 24/7 availability
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can exchange between 11 currencies 24 hours a day, 7 days a week at their preferred rates. This allows users to seize market opportunities at any time and grow their wealth through flexible currency exchange.

promotions.title: Currency Exchange Discount Voucher HKD 126
promotions.highlight: 💱 Get HKD 126 discount on currency exchange
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 126 currency exchange discount voucher as part of the new customer reward package. The voucher is valid for 30 days after receipt and can be used for eligible currency exchange transactions.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: HKD 100 Overseas Remittance Cash Rebate
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Receive HKD 100 rebate on overseas remittance
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 100 overseas remittance cash rebate voucher as part of the welcome package. The voucher can be applied to eligible overseas remittance transactions within 30 days of receipt.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: ZA Card with No Annual or Hidden Fees
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay for convenient mobile payments.

promotions.title: Open an Account in as Fast as 2 Minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Quick and easy account opening in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a streamlined account opening process that can be completed in as fast as 2 minutes when no extra information is required. This service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong.

promotions.title: ZA Credit Loan Referral Program
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 900 for referring friends for loans
promotions.description: Invite friends to apply for loans at ZA Bank and receive cash rewards up to HKD 900 when they successfully take out a loan. The more friends you refer, the more rewards you can earn.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Insurance in 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured in as fast as 3 minutes via smartphone
promotions.description: Complete the insurance application process in as fast as 3 minutes via your smartphone. Choose from various insurance products including life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) options.
promotions.cost: Insurance premiums vary by product and coverage

promotions.title: ZA Bank Zero Brokerage and Custody Fees
promotions.highlight: 📈 Trade stocks with 0 brokerage and 0 custody fees
promotions.description: Trade stocks with zero brokerage fees and zero custody fees. Platform fees as low as USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction. Trade directly with your HKD or USD deposits in your ZA Bank account.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank investment account holders
promotions.cost: Platform fee starting from USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: 0 Brokerage and 0 Custody Fee Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 🏦 0 commission and 0 custody fees on all HK stock trades
promotions.description: Trade Hong Kong stocks with 0 commission, 0 custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18 per transaction. This permanent feature allows unlimited trading without paying traditional brokerage commissions, significantly reducing trading costs.
promotions.quota: All users with active stock trading accounts
promotions.cost: Platform fee from HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Platform Fee for New Crypto Customers
promotions.highlight: 🪙 $0 platform fee for crypto trading for first 90 days
promotions.description: New customers can enjoy $0 platform fee for cryptocurrency trading for the first 90 days after account opening. Trade 24/7 directly with HKD or USD deposits.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Hong Kong Stocks Trading Promotion
promotions.highlight: 🏆 Up to HKD 1,500 cash rewards for new stock trading customers
promotions.description: New customers who activate Hong Kong stocks trading can receive up to HKD 500 cash rewards through ZA Quest, plus up to HKD 1,000 cash rebate when buying stocks. Enjoy 0 commission, 0 custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18.

promotions.title: Hong Kong's No.1 Digital Bank
promotions.highlight: 🏆 First digital bank in Hong Kong with highest user base and deposits
promotions.description: As the first digital bank to launch in Hong Kong, ZA Bank had the highest number of users and customer deposits among the city's eight digital banks as of 30 June 2024. ZA Bank offers 24x7 banking services with convenient digital features.

promotions.title: Refer a Friend for Loan Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💵 Earn up to HKD 900 by referring friends for loans
promotions.description: Existing customers can earn up to HKD 900 in rewards for successfully referring friends who take out loans with ZA Bank. This incentive program rewards customers for bringing in new loan customers.
promotions.quota: All existing ZA Bank account holders

promotions.title: HKD 1,000 Monthly Fee Savings on Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 💰 Save up to HKD 1,000 in monthly trading fees compared to traditional brokers
promotions.description: ZA Bank's stock trading service can save customers up to HKD 1,000 in monthly fees compared to traditional brokers. This calculation is based on making one trade per trading day (approximately 20 trades per month) with zero commission, zero custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18.
promotions.cost: Platform fees apply (from HKD 18 per transaction)

promotions.title: 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🧑‍💼 Round-the-clock customer support
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers 24x7 customer service support to all users. Banking services are always available regardless of time of day, with full customer service access.

promotions.title: Customer Referral Program - Referrer Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🤝 Earn up to HKD 90,000 by referring friends to open accounts
promotions.description: ZA Bank's customer referral program rewards users for referring friends to open accounts. Referrers can earn various rewards based on the number of successful referrals, with top referrers eligible for up to HKD 10,000 per phase across 9 phases of the campaign.
promotions.quota: Available to all existing ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Brokerage & 0% Custody Fees for Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 📈 0 brokerage and 0 custody fees for Hong Kong stocks
promotions.description: Trade Hong Kong stocks with zero commission and zero custody fees. Platform fee is as low as HKD 18 per transaction, allowing users to save up to HKD 1,000 in monthly trading costs compared to traditional brokers.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank users with activated stock trading services
promotions.cost: Platform fee as low as HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: New User HKD 500 Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 💵 Get up to HKD 500 cash reward when opening a new account
promotions.description: Selected customers can receive up to HKD 500 in cash rewards when opening a new ZA Bank account. Customers can complete specific tasks in ZA Quest after successful account opening to receive the reward.
promotions.quota: Selected new customers only; not applicable to customers who opened accounts through referral programs or have received other new customer gifts

promotions.title: New Account HKD 2,026 Welcome Reward
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Get rewards worth HKD 2,026 plus 2.5% stock rebate
promotions.description: New users who open an account using a referral code can receive rewards worth HKD 2,026 including fund position rebate vouchers and stock cash rebate vouchers. Additionally, they can enjoy 2.5% stock rebate on eligible purchases.

promotions.title: Fund Redemption Fee Waiver
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Redemption fee waivers for all funds
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers who have activated fund trading services can enjoy redemption fee waivers for all funds until July 31, 2026. This allows investors to redeem their fund investments without paying any redemption fees.
promotions.quota: All retail banking users who have activated fund trading services

promotions.title: ZA Bank Payment Connect Cross-Border Transfer
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Fee-free real-time transfers between Mainland China and Hong Kong
promotions.description: Send money between Mainland China and Hong Kong in real-time with zero fees using Payment Connect. Instant cross-border transfers without any handling charges.

promotions.title: New Stock Trading Customer Cash Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💵 Up to HKD 1,500 in cash rewards for new stock traders
promotions.description: New users can receive up to HKD 500 in cash rewards for opening an account, plus up to HKD 1,000 in cash rebates for buying stocks. This offer is specifically for Hong Kong stock trading customers.
promotions.cost: Must buy stocks to qualify for portion of rewards

promotions.title: Second 20% p.a. Time Deposit for Multi-Product Usage
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Additional 20% p.a. time deposit for using multiple products
promotions.description: New referred customers who hold deposits, funds, and stocks with a total balance of at least HKD 1,000 within 14 days of opening an account can receive an additional +19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest rate booster coupon, providing a second opportunity to enjoy 20% p.a. interest.
promotions.quota: New referred customers using multiple products

products.description: The EleBank Visa Platinum Card offers exclusive perks and premium benefits with real-time fraud protection through 24/7 shield monitoring. Cardholders enjoy enhanced transaction security with anti-fraud features and access to exclusive airline rewards and cash rebate programs. The card provides star-tier services and premium privileges for qualified customers.
products.highlight: 💳 24/7 real-time fraud protection, exclusive travel and flight perks
features: Cash rebate rewards for airline ticket purchases

products.description: EleBank Personal Loan offers customized interest rates with loan amounts up to 12 times monthly salary or HKD 1,000,000 (whichever is lower). The loan can be approved and disbursed in as fast as 5 minutes from application to funding.
